entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 5175239363214344960: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 21.8635 +/- 0.0193 mas (same row, RUWE 1.15): 45.74 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -172.917, -92.218 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.762 +/- 0.005 solar radii from Tuson et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 15906 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.523.3090T/abstract). Mass 0.79 +/- 0.02 solar masses from Tuson et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 15906 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.523.3090T/abstract). Temperature 4757 +/- 89 K from Tuson et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 15906 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 4,757 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: HD 15906 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffe2c6. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 15906 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,757 K and log g 4.57 (u1 0.724, u2 0.064): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
